facts.text: The skating page checked November 14, 2026 advertises a November 14–January 21 season, but its Wooster Pike notice says the official opening depends on weather and will be announced when conditions allow. The advertised season is not confirmation that the rink is open today.
quote: Our Wooster Pike rink is scheduled to be completed on November 13th, but opening day will depend on Mother Nature!
We'll announce our official opening date as soon as conditions allow.

facts.text: Once operating, Wooster Pike’s posted skating hours are Monday–Saturday 11 a.m.–10 p.m. and Sunday 11 a.m.–9 p.m., with closures for ice maintenance from 2–2:30 p.m. and 6:30–7 p.m. Public skating is first come, first served without online reservations; private rink rentals can still be booked ahead.
quote: Wooster Pike Skating Hours Monday–Saturday 11:00 AM–10:00 PM Sunday 11:00 AM–9:00 PM
Daily Ice Maintenance Breaks 2:00–2:30 PM 6:30–7:00 PM
Ice skating will be available on a first-come, first-served basis.
Online reservations will no longer be available for public skating, but private rink rentals can still be booked in advance.

facts.text: The shared skating instructions direct visitors to the League Station, or to ask a team member for directions, then sign a waiver, pay and collect skates. Admission is $10 for skate rental and one hour of ice time; children aged four or younger skate free. The instructions do not establish a step-free rink entrance, transfer help or adaptive-skating arrangements.
quote: When you arrive, head over to our League Station or ask any Fifty West team member, and we’ll point you in the right direction!
From there, you’ll sign a quick waiver, pay for your session, grab your skates, and you’re ready to hit the ice!
Admission includes skate rental and one hour of ice time. Kids 4 and under skate free.
